The '''battle of RS-32''' was a battle fought during the [[Zaarin insurrection]] for the control of [[RS-32]].

==Prelude==
After [[Defense of ZA-13|repelling]] a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] attack on [[Rope 17]] and [[ZA-13]], which included [[Mag-pulse warhead/Legends|Mag pulse]] [[Warhead/Legends|warheads]], [[Imperial High Command/Legends|Imperial High Command]] wanted more information about the weapon and hoped to be able to use it in the near future. Command also feared that Rogue [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin|Zaarin]] may also have access to the weapon as well.

==Battle==
3 [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defenders]], one of which piloted by [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] arrived first and engaged the [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]] and [[Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle|Escort shuttle]] [[TT-109]]. When the defenses were removed, the TIE Defenders then launched their heavy rockets that broke through the station's shields forcing it to launch [[R60 T-wing interceptor|T-wings]], which were soon shot down, and a [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|transport]] [[Blue (Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport)|Blue]], which carried [[Officer/Legends|Officers]] and was disabled by Stele. The station called for reinforcements, which arrived firstly as [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]], two [[CR92a Assassin-class corvette|Modified corvettes]] [[Rampart (Assassin-class)|Rampart]], [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wings]] and finally [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wings]]. The reinforcements however were held of by Maarek Stele, as [[Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transport|assault transport]] [[Leopard]] boarded and captured the platform, while Escort shuttle [[Sigma 1]] arrived to board the ''Blue'' and capture it and programmed the transport to [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Victory-class Star Destroyer]] [[Sceltor]]. By the time the reinforcements were finished of two more transports from [[Omega]] and [[Lambda]] boarded RS-32 to bring more troops to the platform.

==Aftermath==
Although the mission was a success, Zaarin had used the opportunity to [[Destruction of ZA-13|destroy]] ZA-13, along with most of the remaining TIE Advanced facilities. This was a serious setback for the Empire's manufacturing capabilities. Even worse, was that Zaarin had successfully tracked down the strike team that was leading the attack on RS-32 and [[Destruction of the Grappler|sprung]] a trap.

==Behind the scenes==
The battle was first featured in the [[1994]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']], in which players fly as Maarek Stele. The battle is depicted in the mission "Capture Mag Pulse Weapon", the fifth mission of the game's eighth tour of campaign, "[[Strategic Warfare]]."

This article assumes completion of all "Primary" and "Secondary" and "Bonus" goals completed.
